location_s: Mulino, OR (fab); Canby, OR (assembly, Screaming Circuits)
process_s: online quick-turn standard: PCBpro full-feature online order = 'Online NRE' column of the detailed-capabilities page (1 oz copper, through vias, mechanical drill)

turn_times_fab-ao.condition: must be confirmed by noon PT
'For PCBs with more than 6 layers, lead time is a 2-day turn after the noon PT cutoff'

turn_times_fab-ao.days: Same day to 15 day ('as short as 24 hours'; '1day to 3 weeks')

turn_times_fab-ao.condition: 4:00 pm PT cutoff; build days run 4 PM to 4 PM; ships afternoon of the last build day; weekends/holidays excluded; 'some limitations apply for the shorter lead times'; build time excludes transit

turn_times_assembly-ao.days: 24 h, 48 h, 5 day, 10 day (as named in the FAQ)
turn_times_assembly-ao.condition: all material received by noon = assembly start date; production 24 h Mon-Sat; MSD baking can add up to 48 h on 24/48 h orders; assembly turn is after board fab

via_in_pad_turn_note: No turn rule published. Online products fill vias with solder mask only; filled-and-capped VIP needs a Sunstone custom quote (see profile via_in_pad_note; https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-products/pcb-manufacturing/pcbpro-full-feature lists 'Via fill' only), so its turn is set by the custom quote.

shipping_us-ao.days: not published (allow up to 5 additional days in holiday/weather periods)

shipping_us-ao.unit: business days (2-day grace period in holiday/weather periods)
shipping_us-ao.cost: extra, calculated from UPS/FedEx rates by size/weight/destination

shipping_us-ao.unit: business days, 'arrives with your daily UPS/Fedex delivery Monday - Friday'

shipping_us-ao.method: UPS (Screaming Circuits assembled boards; customer may give own carrier/account)

cutoff_note: Fab: 4:00 pm PT for all orders; 1-day 4-6 L and 2-day >6 L need confirmation by noon PT (https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/order-cut-off-times). Shipping changes by 9:00am PST on ship date. Assembly: materials by noon (https://www.screamingcircuits.com/faq).
times_not_published_as: shipping prices (calculated from carrier sites at checkout)
times_note: Fab 1 day 4-6 L / 2 day >6 L (noon PT), online products same day to 15 days, OneQuote 1 day-3 weeks, 4 pm PT cut-off; ships afternoon of the last build day, free UPS Ground to the continental US, 2nd Day Air / Next Day extra. Assembly at Screaming Circuits (Canby OR) in rolling 24 h days from noon material receipt. Pages read with curl + browser user-agent.
via_in_pad_note: PCBpro online lists 'Via Fill/Plugging: Yes (solder mask filled)' only; no resin/conductive fill or copper cap online. Filled-and-capped via-in-pad needs a custom quote (Sunstone forum per research doc; forum host not re-fetched). https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-products/pcb-manufacturing/pcbpro-full-feature

advanced-o.process_s: Custom Quote column (main capabilities page) / 'Custom' column (detailed capabilities)
advanced-o.note: Main page Custom Quote column: 'Minimum Trace Width 0.002"', 'Smallest Drill Size 0.005"', 'Min. Pad Size (via) via + 0.006"', 'Min. Pad Size (component) hole + 0.010"', layer count '0 - 36', thickness '0.003" - 0.187"', copper '0.25 oz - 6 oz'. No spacing is given there; spacing 0.0762 mm is the detailed page's Custom 1 oz '0.003" / 0.003"' (2 oz: 4/4 mil, 3 oz: 6/6 mil). 'via + 0.006"' read as pad DIAMETER = drill + 0.006" (ring 3 mil per side), consistent with the online column's 'via + 0.010"' which the detailed page words as '0.010" larger than drilled hole size'. Note the detailed page states the via pad as '0.010" larger' for ALL tiers including Custom, so +6 mil is the main page's figure only; confirm on the quote. Aspect ratio for Custom is '>10:1' (no maximum published).

hdi-o.note: Only from the ASC Sunstone 'ultimate PCB source' marketing page: UHDI 'ultra-fine lines and spaces down to 20 microns', 'microvias to 75 microns'. This is an American Standard Circuits group capability, not necessarily made in Mulino; custom quote only (main page: Microvia / Blind/Buried 'No' online, 'Yes' custom). Capture pad, microvia ring, stacked/staggered and lamination cycles are not published.

camera_via_s: 0.15 mm drill / 0.25 mm pad: FAILS the standard online rules (min drill 0.2032 mm, pad = drill + 0.254 mm). Advanced (custom quote, 0.127 mm min drill, pad = via + 0.1524 mm): drill passes, 0.25 mm pad fails; the smallest passing pad on a 0.15 mm drill is 0.3024 mm (use 0.31 mm), custom-quote column only, and only if the main page's 'via + 0.006"' applies (the detailed page says +0.010" for all tiers, which would need 0.404 mm).
note: Sunstone publishes three tiers on the detailed page: Limited Review (5/5 mil at 1 oz, 0.010" smallest drill, 0.020" copper-to-edge, 0.004" mask web, 0.006" silk line, 12x14 in max; tolerances page gives its pad as hole + 0.017"), Online NRE (= PCBpro full feature: 4/4 mil at 1 oz, 5/5 at 2 oz, 7/7 at 3 oz, 0.008" drill, 0.010" edge, 0.003" mask web and silk line, <10:1 aspect, 16x22 in), and Custom (3/3 at 1 oz, <0.008" drill). Top level = Online NRE / PCBpro at 1 oz: 4 mil trace AND 4 mil space are published explicitly, so spacing is no longer assumed. The main page's 'Instant Online' column says 'Minimum Trace Width 0.005"' (no spacing): that matches the Limited Review / 2 oz rows, so design to 5/5 mil if ordering the limited-review product or 2 oz copper. Via pad: vendor words it 'Min. Pad Size (via) via + 0.010"' and '0.010" larger than drilled hole size'; read as pad DIAMETER = drill + 0.010" (5 mil ring per side) because 'larger than the hole size' compares diameters; pad 0.2032 + 0.254 = 0.4572 mm (derived). Layer counts: '1 - 20' (main page) plus the even counts 2-20 of the stackup page; odd counts above 1 not stated. min_silkscreen_height is the 0.050" character height; min_silkscreen_width is the 0.003" character stroke (0.030" is the character width). Fastest fab turn 1 day (OneQuote 1 day; 1-day turns for up to 6 layers if confirmed by noon PT; >6 L 2-day), but PCBpro itself lists '2 day to 15 day'. Assembly: Screaming Circuits (Canby, OR) is a division of Milwaukee Electronics, not ASC; Sunstone calls it 'Our assembly partner' and bundles it into OneQuote orders, hence assembly_b true as a bundled partner, not same company. Impedance controlled online and custom, tolerance not published.
barrel_plating_source-s: Sunstone: "*Plating Target is minimum of 0.0008" in the hole with approximately 0.001" - 0.0014" on the surface." https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/layer-stackup, read 2026-10-15
outer_split_note-s: "1 Oz Selection (1 oz internal layers with 0.5 oz copper foil external layers)"; 4-layer 0.062 construction sheet: "Layer 1 .5 oz foil plated to approximate* thickness 0.0017"". https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/layer-stackup, read 2026-10-15

stackups_note: Stackup selector data (89 rows: copper weight 1/2/3 oz finished x layers x thickness) is embedded in the page's Next.js payload, readable with curl (no JS needed); each row links a construction-sheet PDF on cms.sunstone.com. One stackup per unique construction sheet (sheet code, e.g. L04-062-1ozHoz = 1 oz inner / half-oz outer foil; 1oz1oz; 2oz2oz). Every layer thickness is printed in both in and mm; thickness_mm uses the printed mm. copper_outer_oz is the BASE outer foil weight as printed ('0.5 oz foil plated to approximate* thickness 0.0017'); the page's selector calls these 1 / 2 / 3 oz FINISHED weights (site_copper_weight-s). er: 77 sheets print a sheet-level footnote 'Average Dielectric Constant 4.3 @ 1 GHz / 4.8 @ 1 MHz' (er = 4.3 at 1 GHz used on every dielectric); 8 newer sheets print 'Avg Dk 4.5' / 'Avg DC 4.5' / 'Avg Dielectric Constant 4.5' on each dielectric (er = 4.5). Each layer's er-s says which. The page says these are FR-4 constructions; no laminate brand. None is stated as impedance-controlled. Site data issues: the '2 Oz' 6-layer rows (all 7 thicknesses) link to L06-xxx-1ozHoz sheets identical in numbers to the '1 Oz' ones (sheets with Avg Dk 4.5 instead of the 4.3 footnote) - so no 6-layer 1oz/1oz sheet is published. For the 7 L06-xxx-1ozHoz codes the newer variant (per-layer Avg Dk 4.5, correct printed total) is used; the older variant linked from the '1 Oz' rows has identical layer thicknesses but prints the 4.3 @ 1 GHz footnote and a total short by 0.0014 in (e.g. 0.0608 vs 0.0622). '1 Oz' 8L 0.093 has a duplicate row linking the 8L 0.078 sheet; '1 Oz' 4L 0.078 and '2 Oz' 10L 0.093 rows are duplicated; '1 Oz' 4L 0.093 has no PDF or image (not published); '3 Oz' 4L 0.093 links the 4L 0.039 2oz2oz PDF, so L04-093-2oz2oz was transcribed from its stackup image (it prints two unclad cores with a 2x2116 prepreg between them, as printed). Typos copied as printed (e.g. '1x180'). The example PDF URL under /docs/default-source/layer-stack-up-2022/ returned 404 (superseded by the cms.sunstone.com set). The sheets' own printed totals disagree with the sum of their printed layers on these (measured_total_mm = sum of layers; printed_total-s = sheet's total): L04-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1448 vs printed 3.1598; L08-047-1ozHoz: sum 1.2398 vs printed 1.1684; L08-062-1ozHoz: sum 1.5346 vs printed 1.4630; L08-093-1ozHoz: sum 2.4436 vs printed 2.3724; L08-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1856 vs printed 3.1140; L10-062-1ozHoz: sum 1.5906 vs printed 1.5189; L10-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.2058 vs printed 3.1344; L12-078-1ozHoz: sum 2.0530 vs printed 1.9380; L14-093-1ozHoz: sum 2.4138 vs printed 2.3419; L14-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.2266 vs printed 3.1547; L16-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1810 vs printed 3.1090; L18-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1862 vs printed 3.1140. Left out (a dielectric without thickness or Dk on the sheet): 4 Layer StackUp (0.093") L04-093-2oz2oz. Order: klayout reads the first 8 and takes the first of a layer count, so the 0.062 in 0.5 oz-outer / 1 oz-inner build of 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 layers and the thinnest 12 / 14 / 16 / 18-layer builds come first.
